products.product_description: Abdallah Milk Chocolate Bites CARAMEL, Net Wt 4.5 oz. (127g), UPC 7 6668407116 2, Ingredients: Pure milk chocolate (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, whole milk, soy lecithin (an emulsifier), vanilla), corn syrup, sweetened condensed milk, cream, sugar, palm oil, salt, guar gum. carrageenan, locust bean gum, potassium sorbate (preservative), artificial flavor. Share equipment with items that may contain peanuts, tree nuts, egg. CONTAINS MILK, SOY. GLUTEN FREE. The product is sold in a box of 6 cellophane bags with 8 bites in each bag. Four are wrapped in red and 4 in silver foil.
products.code_info: Date Codes: EJ29 thru EJ31 and EK01 thru EK18
products.reason_for_recall: Abdallah Candies is recalling red and silver foil wrapped Holiday Caramel Bites. One customer reported finding a Peanut Butter Bite wrapped in red foil in a bag of Holiday Caramel Bites.
